back: The repeating contractile unit of a myofibril, from one Z line to the next.
I band: actin only. A band: length of myosin (with overlap). H zone: myosin only. Z line: anchors actin. M line: holds myosin.
Released from the SR; binds troponin; troponin moves tropomyosin; myosin-binding sites on actin exposed.

front: Two uses of ATP at the myosin head
back: Binding of ATP detaches the head from actin; hydrolysis of ATP re-cocks the head.

front: What happens to the bands during contraction?
back: Sarcomere, I band and H zone shorten; A band stays the same.
Infoldings of the sarcolemma that carry action potentials deep into the muscle fibre.

front: Where are calcium ions stored in a muscle fibre?
back: In the sarcoplasmic reticulum; pumped back in by active transport after contraction.
No ATP after death, so myosin heads cannot detach from actin; cross-bridges stay locked.
